title: WCD Maharashtra Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 13 Anganwadi Helper/ Worker Posts
description: The Women and Child Development (WCD) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 13 Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper Jobs. Those candidates who have qualified in Intermediate (10+2) can grab this chance and apply for the WCD Maharashtra Recruitment 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested candidates can apply on or before the last date ...
